title: Paper Trail
description: Customers need a downloadable PDF copy of their invoice for expense reports. Fetch the PDF export and confirm it's actually a valid PDF, not just a file with the right extension.
successCondition: GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/pdf returns 200 with Content-Type application/pdf, and the response body's first bytes are the PDF magic number "%PDF-".
hints: Create an invoice first via POST /api/billing/shipments/:shipmentId/invoice.
A quick sanity check for "is this really a PDF" is checking the first 5 bytes of the response body.
